## What it is

One diameter of the coil. Two clips, the lower half of the centre lap, and the flat that clocks the pin. Print it flat.

## Design notes

- The layer plane is the C of the clip. Prying the tube out of the mouth loads that plane, along the perimeters, which is the orientation that survived on the bench. A clip printed with the tube lying in the layers split.
- The bore is lofted along the helix, so the tube centre rises and bows inside the 14 mm thickness. The loft sections stay parallel to the bed. The wall tilt is the helix angle, about 5°, not a bridged ceiling.
- The lap slot is 0.3 mm wider than the other cross's 14 mm thickness. The pin hole is a 45° teardrop toward the top of the print, because that hole is horizontal on the bed.
- Centre-line radius is 43.5 mm. Outside of the coil is 100 mm.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't stand this piece on end. That puts the layer lines along the tube again.
- Don't close the lap slot. The high cross has to drop in from above.
- Don't drop the pin hole under a 45° roof. It is a horizontal hole when this lies flat.
